sections.title: WHAT IS SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION?
bullets: Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) is a treatment using pigment to achieve the visual effect of thick, short-cut hair. Unlike transplantation, it involves no surgery, leaves no scars, and offers quick results.
It is intended for men with pronounced baldness or thinning hair who want a discreet but effective solution without surgery.

SMP treatment is especially effective for men with short hair (1–2 mm length) because the pigment in the skin blends perfectly with the natural hair appearance. This look produces a density effect that looks completely natural and subtle even up close.
Compared to transplantation, which typically adds 3,000–5,000 hairs, SMP can cover the entire scalp with up to 60,000 pigment dots – creating a more uniform and visually denser result.
SMP also allows shaping a natural hairline – individually adapted to face shape, age, and aesthetics, with no compromises on what looks natural.
